ground.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game terrain material atlas for Crownforge, original lush painterly fantasy meadow with the confident broad hand-painted shapes and warm green highlights of a high-end stylized MMORPG. Generate one square opaque PNG containing EXACTLY four equal SQUARE seamless top-down terrain textures arranged in a clean 2 by 2 grid, no borders, no labels, no gaps. TOP LEFT: lush low meadow turf, overlapping sculpted curved grass blades, soft dark jade and forest green roots, sage and fresh warm green tips, subtle tiny clover, luxurious organic directional bunches. TOP RIGHT: same meadow in sunnier drier grass, muted golden sage olive green, occasional warm earth peeking through, still mostly grass. BOTTOM LEFT: shaded woodland floor, cool mossy greens with sparse small leaf litter and rich soft brown soil, restrained contrast. BOTTOM RIGHT: lush cool moss and low clover meadow, broad clusters of little rounded leaves and tiny grass blades. Each quadrant must tile seamlessly on all four edges by itself. Fine-to-medium scale painted detail, consistent scale in every quadrant, blade bunches about 1/14 quadrant width, no obvious large focal objects, no repetition pattern. Lighting diffuse upper left, soft ambient occlusion at roots, gentle luminous tips; sophisticated harmonious sage, fern, deep emerald, warm citron palette, never neon. Straight overhead orthographic material view, no horizon, no perspective, no upright grass sprites, no trees, no rocks, no buildings, no characters, no flowers larger than tiny pinpricks, no text, no watermark. Dense authored hand-painted game art, not photorealistic lawn photography, not random grain, not blurry noise. Full bleed 2048 by 2048 if possible. This is an original Crownforge game asset, not any copied Blizzard artwork.

grass.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an original production-ready transparent PNG sprite atlas for a lush hand-painted fantasy strategy game, Crownforge. Rich broad tapered grass blade shapes, softly painted bevel highlights, dark fern and jade roots, sage-green bodies and warm citron green tips. Deliberately legible silhouettes at tiny game size; gorgeous cohesive stylized MMORPG environment art, hand-painted rather than photoreal. SECOND ROW: four varied medium-height slim grass clusters with arching tips, some seed heads, one sunlit straw-green type, one cool blue-green type, dense but graceful. BOTTOM ROW: one low clover cluster, one grass cluster with tiny ivory meadow flowers, one low grass patch with tiny faded lavender flower heads, one ferny low meadow cluster. All plants have clean individual leaves and connected intact bases, no severed stems or artificial outlines, no dirt clods, no rocks, no brown soil, NO GROUND SHADOW, no rectangular mats.
